{{Conjecture|legends}}
After the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|formation]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the new [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government established an '''outpost''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carosi XII]]. It was close to [[Newlife Point]], the only [[City/Legends|city]] on the world which was inhabited by the [[Carosite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Built into the side of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] near the northern shore of the [[Avuae Sea]], its location was not disclosed to off-worlders. [[Balderik Rajana]] was the base's [[Commander/Legends|commander]].
